title: Internships and Work Experience
lead: Crown Power opens internship and work-experience placements for students and early-career candidates across engineering, energy, business and more.
body: Our placements are designed to give participants a genuine insight into how a modern energy-engineering business operates, spanning multiple disciplines.
Terms are confirmed on an individual basis. See the Internships page for programme details and how to apply.

title: Smart Cat's Eyes Road Sign System with AI Integration
lead: A perspective on intelligent road-marking and sign systems that combine visibility technology with AI-driven awareness.
body: This statement explores how established road-safety concepts could be enhanced with sensing and intelligent integration.

title: Transforming Energy Infrastructure through AI-Powered Electrical Engineering
lead: How artificial intelligence and data can support the design, monitoring and optimisation of electrical infrastructure.
body: A look at the role intelligent systems can play across the lifecycle of energy infrastructure, from design through to operation.

title: Pioneering the Future of Energy: AI-Powered Electrical Engineering
lead: Crown Power sets out its interest in combining electrical engineering expertise with modern, data-driven tools.
body: An introduction to the thinking behind Crown Power’s approach to smart, sustainable and reliable energy systems.
